Assign the clips to several reviewers

Source: R/reviewers.R
assign_reviewers.Rd

Splits the clips of a manifest among reviewers, balanced within each species, and gives a fraction of them to a second reviewer, so that the agreement between reviewers can be measured with reviewer_agreement(). The overlap is drawn within each species, so every species gets doubly reviewed clips.

Usage

assign_reviewers(manifest, reviewers, overlap = 0.1, seed = 2026)

Arguments

manifest

Clip manifest, as returned by select_clips() or cut_clips().

reviewers

Names of the reviewers (at least two).

overlap

Fraction of the clips of each species reviewed by two reviewers.

seed

Seed of the draws. The global random number generator is left as it was.

Value

The manifest with reviewer (the first reviewer of each clip) and second_reviewer (NA for clips reviewed once).

Details

Cut the clips with cut_clips() first, then copy each reviewer's share to their own folder with split_by_reviewer().
